@Configuration
public class OpenApiGroupConfiguration {
    
    @Bean
    @Primary
    public GroupedOpenApi publicApi() {
        return GroupedOpenApi.builder()
            .group("public")
            .displayName("Public API")
            .pathsToMatch("/api/v1/public/**", "/api/v1/auth/**")
            .build();
    }
    
    @Bean
    public GroupedOpenApi userApi() {
        return GroupedOpenApi.builder()
            .group("user")
            .displayName("User API")
            .pathsToMatch("/api/v1/users/**", "/api/v1/profile/**")
            .addOperationCustomizer((operation, handlerMethod) -> {
                operation.addSecurityItem(new SecurityRequirement().addList("bearerAuth"));
                return operation;
            })
            .build();
    }
    
    @Bean
    public GroupedOpenApi adminApi() {
        return GroupedOpenApi.builder()
            .group("admin")
            .displayName("Admin API")
            .pathsToMatch("/api/v1/admin/**")
            .addOperationCustomizer((operation, handlerMethod) -> {
                operation.addSecurityItem(new SecurityRequirement().addList("bearerAuth"));
                // 添加管理員 API 的額外標籤
                operation.addTagsItem("Admin Only");
                return operation;
            })
            .build();
    }
    
    @Bean
    public GroupedOpenApi internalApi() {
        return GroupedOpenApi.builder()
            .group("internal")
            .displayName("Internal API")
            .pathsToMatch("/api/internal/**")
            .addOperationCustomizer((operation, handlerMethod) -> {
                operation.addSecurityItem(new SecurityRequirement().addList("apiKey"));
                return operation;
            })
            .build();
    }
}

@Component
public class CustomOperationCustomizer implements OperationCustomizer {
    
    @Override
    public Operation customize(Operation operation, HandlerMethod handlerMethod) {
        // 自動添加通用錯誤回應
        addCommonErrorResponses(operation);
        
        // 為分頁端點添加通用參數
        if (isPaginationEndpoint(handlerMethod)) {
            addPaginationParameters(operation);
        }
        
        // 添加請求追蹤資訊
        addRequestTrackingInfo(operation);
        
        return operation;
    }
    
    private void addCommonErrorResponses(Operation operation) {
        ApiResponses responses = operation.getResponses();
        
        if (responses.get("400") == null) {
            responses.addApiResponse("400", new ApiResponse()
                .description("請求參數錯誤")
                .content(new Content()
                    .addMediaType("application/json", new MediaType()
                        .schema(new Schema<>().$ref("#/components/schemas/Error")))));
        }
        
        if (responses.get("500") == null) {
            responses.addApiResponse("500", new ApiResponse()
                .description("內部伺服器錯誤")
                .content(new Content()
                    .addMediaType("application/json", new MediaType()
                        .schema(new Schema<>().$ref("#/components/schemas/Error")))));
        }
    }
    
    private boolean isPaginationEndpoint(HandlerMethod handlerMethod) {
        return Arrays.stream(handlerMethod.getMethodParameters())
            .anyMatch(param -> Pageable.class.isAssignableFrom(param.getParameterType()));
    }
    
    private void addPaginationParameters(Operation operation) {
        if (operation.getParameters() == null) {
            operation.setParameters(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        
        // 添加通用分頁參數
        operation.getParameters().add(new Parameter()
            .name("page")
            .in(ParameterIn.QUERY)
            .description("頁碼（從 0 開始）")
            .schema(new IntegerSchema().minimum(BigDecimal.ZERO)._default(0)));
            
        operation.getParameters().add(new Parameter()
            .name("size")
            .in(ParameterIn.QUERY)
            .description("每頁大小")
            .schema(new IntegerSchema().minimum(BigDecimal.ONE).maximum(BigDecimal.valueOf(100))._default(20)));
    }
    
    private void addRequestTrackingInfo(Operation operation) {
        operation.addExtension("x-request-id", "自動生成的請求追蹤 ID");
        operation.addExtension("x-rate-limit", "API 呼叫頻率限制資訊");
    }
}

@Component
public class CustomModelConverter implements ModelConverter {
    
    @Override
    public ModelConverterContext resolve(
        AnnotatedType annotatedType,
        ModelConverterContext context,
        Iterator<ModelConverter> chain
    ) {
        if (chain.hasNext()) {
            context = chain.next().resolve(annotatedType, context, chain);
        }
        
        // 自訂枚舉處理
        if (annotatedType.getType() instanceof Class<?> clazz && clazz.isEnum()) {
            Schema<?> schema = context.getDefinedModels().get(annotatedType.getType().getTypeName());
            if (schema != null) {
                enhanceEnumSchema(schema, clazz);
            }
        }
        
        return context;
    }
    
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private void enhanceEnumSchema(Schema<?> schema, Class<?> enumClass) {
        if (enumClass.isEnum()) {
            Enum<?>[] enumConstants = (Enum<?>[]) enumClass.getEnumConstants();
            
            List<String> enumValues = Arrays.stream(enumConstants)
                .map(Enum::name)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
                
            schema.setEnum(enumValues);
            
            // 添加枚舉描述
            StringBuilder description = new StringBuilder(schema.getDescription() != null ? 
                schema.getDescription() : "");
            description.append("\n\n可用值：\n");
            
            for (Enum<?> enumConstant : enumConstants) {
                description.append("- `").append(enumConstant.name()).append("`");
                
                // 如果枚舉有描述方法，添加描述
                try {
                    Method getDescription = enumClass.getMethod("getDescription");
                    Object desc = getDescription.invoke(enumConstant);
                    if (desc != null) {
                        description.append(": ").append(desc);
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    // 忽略沒有 getDescription 方法的情況
                }
                
                description.append("\n");
            }
            
            schema.setDescription(description.toString());
        }
    }
}

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@TestMethodOrder(OrderAnnotation.class)
class OpenApiDocumentationTest {
    
    @Autowired
    private TestRestTemplate restTemplate;
    
    @LocalServerPort
    private int port;
    
    @Test
    @Order(1)
    void testOpenApiJsonGeneration() {
        String url = "http://localhost:" + port + "/api-docs";
        
        ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.getForEntity(url, String.class);
        
        assertThat(response.getStatusCode()).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.OK);
        assertThat(response.getBody()).isNotNull();
        
        // 驗證 JSON 結構
        DocumentContext context = JsonPath.parse(response.getBody());
        assertThat(context.read("$.openapi", String.class)).isEqualTo("3.0.1");
        assertThat(context.read("$.info.title", String.class)).isNotEmpty();
        assertThat(context.read("$.paths", Map.class)).isNotEmpty();
    }
    
    @Test
    @Order(2)
    void testSwaggerUiAccess() {
        String url = "http://localhost:" + port + "/swagger-ui.html";
        
        ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.getForEntity(url, String.class);
        
        assertThat(response.getStatusCode()).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.OK);
        assertThat(response.getBody()).contains("Swagger UI");
    }
    
    @Test
    @Order(3)
    void testApiGroupsGeneration() {
        String[] groups = {"public", "user", "admin", "internal"};
        
        for (String group : groups) {
            String url = "http://localhost:" + port + "/api-docs/" + group;
            ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.getForEntity(url, String.class);
            
            assertThat(response.getStatusCode()).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.OK);
            
            DocumentContext context = JsonPath.parse(response.getBody());
            assertThat(context.read("$.paths", Map.class)).isNotEmpty();
        }
    }
    
    @Test
    @Order(4)
    void testSecuritySchemesDefinition() {
        String url = "http://localhost:" + port + "/api-docs";
        
        ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.getForEntity(url, String.class);
        DocumentContext context = JsonPath.parse(response.getBody());
        
        // 驗證安全方案定義
        assertThat(context.read("$.components.securitySchemes.bearerAuth.type", String.class))
            .isEqualTo("http");
        assertThat(context.read("$.components.securitySchemes.apiKey.type", String.class))
            .isEqualTo("apiKey");
    }
}

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
class ApiContractTest {
    
    @Autowired
    private TestRestTemplate restTemplate;
    
    @Autowired
    private ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    
    @LocalServerPort
    private int port;
    
    @Test
    void testUserApiContract() throws Exception {
        // 獲取 OpenAPI 規範
        String openApiJson = getOpenApiJson();
        OpenAPIV3Parser parser = new OpenAPIV3Parser();
        OpenAPI openAPI = parser.readContents(openApiJson).getOpenAPI();
        
        // 測試用戶創建端點
        PathItem userPath = openAPI.getPaths().get("/api/v1/users");
        assertThat(userPath).isNotNull();
        
        Operation postOperation = userPath.getPost();
        assertThat(postOperation).isNotNull();
        assertThat(postOperation.getSummary()).isEqualTo("創建新用戶");
        
        // 驗證請求 Schema
        RequestBody requestBody = postOperation.getRequestBody();
        assertThat(requestBody).isNotNull();
        
        Content content = requestBody.getContent();
        MediaType mediaType = content.get("application/json");
        assertThat(mediaType).isNotNull();
        
        // 驗證回應 Schema
        ApiResponse response201 = postOperation.getResponses().get("201");
        assertThat(response201).isNotNull();
        assertThat(response201.getDescription()).isEqualTo("用戶創建成功");
    }
    
    @Test
    void testActualApiMatchesContract() throws Exception {
        // 根據文檔測試實際 API
        String requestJson = """
            {
              "username": "test_user",
              "email": "test@example.com",
              "firstName": "Test",
              "lastName": "User",
              "password": "TestPassword123!"
            }
            """;
        
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        headers.setBearerAuth("valid-jwt-token");
        
        HttpEntity<String> request = new HttpEntity<>(requestJson, headers);
        
        // 假設這個端點在測試環境中可用
        String url = "http://localhost:" + port + "/api/v1/users";
        ResponseEntity<String> response = restTemplate.postForEntity(url, request, String.class);
        
        // 根據文檔，應該返回 201 或 401（如果沒有有效 token）
        assertThat(response.getStatusCode())
            .isIn(HttpStatus.CREATED, HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
    }
    
    private String getOpenApiJson() {
        String url = "http://localhost:" + port + "/api-docs";
        return restTemplate.getForObject(url, String.class);
    }
}

#!/bin/bash
# scripts/generate-api-docs.sh

set -e

echo "🚀 生成 API 文檔..."

# 啟動應用程式
echo "啟動 Spring Boot 應用程式..."
java -jar target/api-service.jar --server.port=8080 &
APP_PID=$!

# 等待應用程式啟動
echo "等待應用程式啟動..."
for i in {1..30}; do
    if curl -s http://localhost:8080/actuator/health > /dev/null; then
        echo "應用程式已啟動"
        break
    fi
    sleep 2
done

# 生成 OpenAPI JSON
echo "下載 OpenAPI 規範..."
curl -o docs/openapi.json http://localhost:8080/api-docs

# 生成不同格式的文檔
echo "生成 HTML 文檔..."
npx @redocly/openapi-cli build-docs docs/openapi.json --output docs/api.html

echo "生成 Markdown 文檔..."
npx widdershins docs/openapi.json -o docs/api.md

# 生成客戶端 SDK
echo "生成客戶端 SDK..."
mkdir -p generated/java-client
npx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate \
    -i docs/openapi.json \
    -g java \
    -o generated/java-client \
    --additional-properties=invokerPackage=com.example.client

# 停止應用程式
echo "停止應用程式..."
kill $APP_PID

echo "✅ API 文檔生成完成"

# .github/workflows/api-docs.yml
name: Generate API Documentation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  generate-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up JDK 17
      uses: actions/setup-java@v3
      with:
        java-version: '17'
        distribution: 'temurin'
        
    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: ~/.m2
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        
    - name: Build application
      run: mvn clean package -DskipTests
      
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        
    - name: Install documentation tools
      run: |
        npm install -g @redocly/openapi-cli
        npm install -g widdershins
        npm install -g @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli
        
    - name: Generate API documentation
      run: |
        chmod +x scripts/generate-api-docs.sh
        ./scripts/generate-api-docs.sh
        
    - name: Upload documentation artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: api-documentation
        path: |
          docs/
          generated/
          
    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./docs

@Configuration
public class OpenApiPerformanceConfiguration {
    
    @Bean
    @ConditionalOnProperty(name = "springdoc.api-docs.enabled", havingValue = "true")
    public OpenApiCustomiser openApiCustomiser() {
        return openApi -> {
            // 移除不必要的 Schema
            removeUnusedSchemas(openApi);
            
            // 簡化複雜的嵌套對象
            simplifyNestedObjects(openApi);
            
            // 添加快取頭
            addCacheHeaders(openApi);
        };
    }
    
    private void removeUnusedSchemas(OpenAPI openApi) {
        if (openApi.getComponents() != null && openApi.getComponents().getSchemas() != null) {
            Set<String> usedSchemas = findUsedSchemas(openApi);
            openApi.getComponents().getSchemas().entrySet()
                .removeIf(entry -> !usedSchemas.contains(entry.getKey()));
        }
    }
    
    private Set<String> findUsedSchemas(OpenAPI openApi) {
        Set<String> usedSchemas = new HashSet<>();
        
        if (openApi.getPaths() != null) {
            openApi.getPaths().values().forEach(pathItem -> {
                Stream.of(
                    pathItem.getGet(), pathItem.getPost(), pathItem.getPut(),
                    pathItem.getDelete(), pathItem.getPatch()
                ).filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .forEach(operation -> collectUsedSchemas(operation, usedSchemas));
            });
        }
        
        return usedSchemas;
    }
    
    private void collectUsedSchemas(Operation operation, Set<String> usedSchemas) {
        // 從請求體收集
        if (operation.getRequestBody() != null && 
            operation.getRequestBody().getContent() != null) {
            operation.getRequestBody().getContent().values()
                .forEach(mediaType -> collectSchemaRefs(mediaType.getSchema(), usedSchemas));
        }
        
        // 從回應收集
        if (operation.getResponses() != null) {
            operation.getResponses().values().forEach(response -> {
                if (response.getContent() != null) {
                    response.getContent().values()
                        .forEach(mediaType -> collectSchemaRefs(mediaType.getSchema(), usedSchemas));
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    private void collectSchemaRefs(Schema<?> schema, Set<String> usedSchemas) {
        if (schema != null) {
            if (schema.get$ref() != null) {
                String schemaName = schema.get$ref().substring("#/components/schemas/".length());
                usedSchemas.add(schemaName);
            }
            
            // 遞迴處理嵌套 Schema
            if (schema.getProperties() != null) {
                schema.getProperties().values().forEach(prop -> 
                    collectSchemaRefs((Schema<?>) prop, usedSchemas));
            }
        }
    }
}

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api-docs")
public class CachedApiDocsController {
    
    private final SpringDocConfigProperties springDocConfigProperties;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    private final Cache<String, String> apiDocsCache;
    
    public CachedApiDocsController(
        SpringDocConfigProperties springDocConfigProperties,
        ObjectMapper objectMapper
    ) {
        this.springDocConfigProperties = springDocConfigProperties;
        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
        this.apiDocsCache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
            .maximumSize(10)
            .expireAfterWrite(Duration.ofMinutes(30))
            .build();
    }
    
    @GetMapping(
        value = "/{group}",
        produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE
    )
    public ResponseEntity<String> getCachedApiDocs(
        @PathVariable String group,
        HttpServletRequest request
    ) {
        String cacheKey = group + "_" + getVersionHash();
        
        String cachedDocs = apiDocsCache.get(cacheKey, key -> {
            // 生成文檔的邏輯
            return generateApiDocs(group);
        });
        
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
            .cacheControl(CacheControl.maxAge(Duration.ofHours(1)))
            .eTag(calculateETag(cachedDocs))
            .body(cachedDocs);
    }
    
    private String getVersionHash() {
        // 基於應用程式版本和配置生成雜湊
        String version = getClass().getPackage().getImplementationVersion();
        return DigestUtils.md5Hex(version != null ? version : "dev");
    }
    
    private String calculateETag(String content) {
        return "\"" + DigestUtils.md5Hex(content) + "\"";
    }
}

@Component
public class ApiUsageTracker {
    
    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
    private final Counter apiCallsCounter;
    private final Timer apiResponseTimer;
    
    public ApiUsageTracker(MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
        this.apiCallsCounter = Counter.builder("api.calls")
            .description("API 呼叫次數")
            .register(meterRegistry);
        this.apiResponseTimer = Timer.builder("api.response.time")
            .description("API 回應時間")
            .register(meterRegistry);
    }
    
    @EventListener
    public void trackApiCall(ApiCallEvent event) {
        apiCallsCounter
            .tag("endpoint", event.getEndpoint())
            .tag("method", event.getMethod())
            .tag("status", String.valueOf(event.getStatusCode()))
            .increment();
            
        apiResponseTimer
            .tag("endpoint", event.getEndpoint())
            .record(event.getResponseTime(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
    }
}

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/analytics")
@Tag(name = "API Analytics", description = "API 使用情況分析")
public class ApiAnalyticsController {
    
    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
    
    public ApiAnalyticsController(MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
    }
    
    @GetMapping("/metrics")
    @Operation(summary = "獲取 API 使用統計")
    public ResponseEntity<ApiMetrics> getApiMetrics() {
        Map<String, Double> endpointCalls = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, Double> averageResponseTimes = new HashMap<>();
        
        meterRegistry.getMeters().forEach(meter -> {
            if (meter instanceof Counter counter && meter.getId().getName().equals("api.calls")) {
                String endpoint = meter.getId().getTag("endpoint");
                endpointCalls.put(endpoint, counter.count());
            }
            
            if (meter instanceof Timer timer && meter.getId().getName().equals("api.response.time")) {
                String endpoint = meter.getId().getTag("endpoint");
                averageResponseTimes.put(endpoint, timer.mean(TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
            }
        });
        
        ApiMetrics metrics = new ApiMetrics(endpointCalls, averageResponseTimes);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(metrics);
    }
}

Swagger/OpenAPI 是現代 API 開發的必備工具，提供了從文檔生成到測試、監控的完整解決方案。透過本文的深入介紹，我們了解到：

item.title: MergeSort - 合併排序算法深度解析與企業應用
item.description:
核心概念

Merge Sort 是基於分治法（Divide and Conquer）的排序演算法：

  1. Divide：將陣列從中點分成兩半
  2. Conquer：遞迴排序兩個子陣列
  3. Combine：合併兩個已排序的子陣列

時間複雜度：所有情況均為 O(n log n) 空間複雜度：O(n)（標準 out-of-place），O(1) 輔助空間（in-place 版本代價高） 穩定排序：是（stable sort，相同元素的相對順序不變）

    J & K --> N["[2, 9]"]

public class MergeSort {
    public static void sort(int[] arr) {
        if (arr.length <= 1) return;
        int mid = arr.length / 2;
        int[] left = Arrays.copyOfRange(arr, 0, mid);
        int[] right = Arrays.copyOfRange(arr, mid, arr.length);
        sort(left);
        sort(right);
        merge(arr, left, right);
    }

    private static void merge(int[] arr, int[] left, int[] right) {
        int i = 0, j = 0, k = 0;
        while (i < left.length && j < right.length) {
            // 穩定排序的關鍵：相等時優先取左邊
            if (left[i] <= right[j]) {
                arr[k++] = left[i++];
            } else {
                arr[k++] = right[j++];
            }
        }
        while (i < left.length)  arr[k++] = left[i++];
        while (j < right.length) arr[k++] = right[j++];
    }
}

為什麼說 Merge Sort 是「穩定」排序

「穩定」指的是：相同值的元素，排序後保持原始相對順序。

item.title: Java Map 按 Value 排序：完整實作與效能優化指南
item.description:
概述

在 Java 程式開發中，經常需要對 Map 集合按照 Value 值進行排序。Map 本身並不保證元素的順序，因此需要採用特定的技術來實現按 Value 排序。本文將深入介紹多種實作方式，並分析其效能特徵和適用場景。

核心概念

  • Map 排序特性：Map 接口本身不提供排序功能
  • 排序策略：通過轉換為 List 或使用 Stream API 實現
  • 排序穩定性：保持相等元素的相對順序
  • 效能考量：時間複雜度和空間複雜度的權衡

常見應用場景

  1. 統計排名：字頻統計、用戶評分排序
  2. 資料分析：銷售數據排序、效能指標排名
  3. 快取管理：LRU 快取的熱點資料排序
  4. 搜尋結果：相關性得分排序

實作方法一：Collections.sort + Map.Entry

1. 基礎實作

這是最傳統且直觀的方法，通過將 Map 的 entrySet 轉換為 List 進行排序。

package com.example.sorting;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class MapSortingExample {
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // 創建測試資料
        Map<String, Integer> wordFrequency = createSampleData();
        
        // 方法一：使用 Collections.sort 排序
        Map<String, Integer> sortedByValue = sortByValueUsingCollections(wordFrequency);
        System.out.println("排序結果: " + sortedByValue);
    }
    
    /**
     * 使用 Collections.sort 按 Value 排序（降序）
     */
    public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortByValueUsingCollections(Map<K, V> map) {
        // 將 Map 的 entrySet 轉換為 List
        List<Map.Entry<K, V>> list = new ArrayList<>(map.entrySet());
        
        // 使用 Collections.sort 排序
        Collections.sort(list, new Comparator<Map.Entry<K, V>>() {
            @Override
            public int compare(Map.Entry<K, V> entry1, Map.Entry<K, V> entry2) {
                // 降序排列：entry2 - entry1
                return entry2.getValue().compareTo(entry1.getValue());
            }
        });
        
        // 將排序後的結果放入 LinkedHashMap 保持順序
        Map<K, V> sortedMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Map.Entry<K, V> entry : list) {
            sortedMap.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
        
        return sortedMap;
    }
    
    /**
     * 創建測試資料
     */
    private static Map<String, Integer> createSampleData() {
        Map<String, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        map.put("apple", 10);
        map.put("banana", 25);
        map.put("cherry", 5);
        map.put("date", 15);
        map.put("elderberry", 30);
        return map;
    }
}

/**
 * 使用 Lambda 表達式簡化比較器
 */
public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortByValueWithLambda(Map<K, V> map) {
    List<Map.Entry<K, V>> list = new ArrayList<>(map.entrySet());
    
    // Lambda 表達式簡化比較器
    Collections.sort(list, (entry1, entry2) -> 
        entry2.getValue().compareTo(entry1.getValue())
    );
    
    Map<K, V> sortedMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<K, V> entry : list) {
        sortedMap.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }
    
    return sortedMap;
}

/**
 * 更簡潔的 Lambda 版本，支援升序/降序
 */
public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortByValue(
        Map<K, V> map, boolean ascending) {
    
    List<Map.Entry<K, V>> list = new ArrayList<>(map.entrySet());
    
    if (ascending) {
        Collections.sort(list, Map.Entry.comparingByValue());
    } else {
        Collections.sort(list, Map.Entry.<K, V>comparingByValue().reversed());
    }
    
    return list.stream()
               .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                   Map.Entry::getKey, 
                   Map.Entry::getValue,
                   (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue, 
                   LinkedHashMap::new
               ));
}

              .collect(Collectors.toMap(

/**
 * 使用 TreeMap 實現按 Value 排序
 * 注意：此方法適用於 Value 值唯一的情況
 */
public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortByValueUsingTreeMap(Map<K, V> map) {
    // 創建一個以 Value 為 Key 的 TreeMap
    TreeMap<V, K> reversedMap = new TreeMap<>(Collections.reverseOrder());
    
    for (Map.Entry<K, V> entry : map.entrySet()) {
        reversedMap.put(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey());
    }
    
    // 重新構建原始格式的 Map
    Map<K, V> sortedMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<V, K> entry : reversedMap.entrySet()) {
        sortedMap.put(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey());
    }
    
    return sortedMap;
}

/**
 * 處理重複 Value 的 TreeMap 排序
 */
public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortByValueWithDuplicates(Map<K, V> map) {
    // 使用 TreeMap，Key 為複合鍵：Value + 原始Key
    TreeMap<String, Map.Entry<K, V>> sortedTreeMap = new TreeMap<>((key1, key2) -> {
        String[] parts1 = key1.split("###");
        String[] parts2 = key2.split("###");
        
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        V value1 = (V) parts1[0];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") 
        V value2 = (V) parts2[0];
        
        int valueComparison = value2.compareTo(value1); // 降序
        if (valueComparison != 0) {
            return valueComparison;
        }
        return parts1[1].compareTo(parts2[1]); // 按原始 Key 排序
    });
    
    for (Map.Entry<K, V> entry : map.entrySet()) {
        String compositeKey = entry.getValue() + "###" + entry.getKey();
        sortedTreeMap.put(compositeKey, entry);
    }
    
    Map<K, V> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<K, V> entry : sortedTreeMap.values()) {
        result.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }
    
    return result;
}

/**
 * 通過排序 Key 列表實現間接排序
 * 適用於需要保留原始 Map 的場景
 */
public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> List<K> sortKeysByValue(
        Map<K, V> map, boolean ascending) {
    
    List<K> keys = new ArrayList<>(map.keySet());
    
    Collections.sort(keys, (key1, key2) -> {
        V value1 = map.get(key1);
        V value2 = map.get(key2);
        
        if (ascending) {
            return value1.compareTo(value2);
        } else {
            return value2.compareTo(value1);
        }
    });
    
    return keys;
}

/**
 * 使用排序後的 Key 列表創建新的有序 Map
 */
public static <K, V> Map<K, V> createSortedMapFromKeys(Map<K, V> originalMap, List<K> sortedKeys) {
    Map<K, V> sortedMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    for (K key : sortedKeys) {
        sortedMap.put(key, originalMap.get(key));
    }
    return sortedMap;
}

/**
 * 自訂物件作為 Value 的排序
 */
public static class ScoreData implements Comparable<ScoreData> {
    private final int score;
    private final String level;
    
    public ScoreData(int score, String level) {
        this.score = score;
        this.level = level;
    }
    
    @Override
    public int compareTo(ScoreData other) {
        int scoreComparison = Integer.compare(other.score, this.score); // 分數降序
        if (scoreComparison != 0) {
            return scoreComparison;
        }
        return this.level.compareTo(other.level); // 等級升序
    }
    
    // getter, setter, toString 方法
    public int getScore() { return score; }
    public String getLevel() { return level; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("ScoreData{score=%d, level='%s'}", score, level);
    }
}

/**
 * 排序包含自訂物件的 Map
 */
public static Map<String, ScoreData> sortByScoreData(Map<String, ScoreData> map) {
    return map.entrySet()
              .stream()
              .sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
              .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                  Map.Entry::getKey,
                  Map.Entry::getValue,
                  (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue,
                  LinkedHashMap::new
              ));
}

package com.example.performance;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

public class MapSortingPerformanceTest {
    
    private static final int[] DATA_SIZES = {1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println("Map Sorting Performance Comparison");
        System.out.println("=====================================");
        
        for (int size : DATA_SIZES) {
            System.out.printf("\nTesting with %d elements:\n", size);
            Map<String, Integer> testData = generateTestData(size);
            
            runPerformanceTest("Collections.sort", testData, 
                MapSortingExample::sortByValueUsingCollections);
                
            runPerformanceTest("Stream API", testData, 
                map -> sortByValueUsingStream(map, false));
                
            runPerformanceTest("Parallel Stream", testData, 
                map -> sortByValueParallel(map, false));
        }
    }
    
    private static void runPerformanceTest(String method, Map<String, Integer> data, 
                                         SortingFunction<String, Integer> sortFunction) {
        // 預熱
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            sortFunction.sort(new HashMap<>(data));
        }
        
        // 正式測試
        long startTime = System.nanoTime();
        Map<String, Integer> result = sortFunction.sort(new HashMap<>(data));
        long endTime = System.nanoTime();
        
        long duration = TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(endTime - startTime);
        System.out.printf("  %-15s: %4d ms (result size: %d)\n", 
                         method, duration, result.size());
    }
    
    private static Map<String, Integer> generateTestData(int size) {
        Map<String, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
        Random random = new Random(42); // 固定種子確保可重現性
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            String key = "key" + i;
            Integer value = random.nextInt(1000);
            map.put(key, value);
        }
        
        return map;
    }
    
    @FunctionalInterface
    interface SortingFunction<K, V> {
        Map<K, V> sort(Map<K, V> map);
    }
}

/**
 * 記憶體使用監控工具
 */
public class MemoryAnalyzer {
    
    public static void analyzeMemoryUsage(String testName, Runnable test) {
        System.gc(); // 建議垃圾回收
        
        Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
        long beforeMemory = runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
        
        test.run();
        
        long afterMemory = runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
        long memoryUsed = afterMemory - beforeMemory;
        
        System.out.printf("%s - Memory used: %.2f MB\n", 
                         testName, memoryUsed / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
    }
}

/**
 * 文本字頻統計與排序應用
 */
public class WordFrequencyAnalyzer {
    
    /**
     * 統計文本中的字頻並排序
     */
    public static Map<String, Integer> analyzeWordFrequency(String text, int topN) {
        // 文本預處理和字頻統計
        Map<String, Integer> wordCount = Arrays.stream(text.toLowerCase()
                                                          .replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z\\s]", "")
                                                          .split("\\s+"))
                                              .filter(word -> !word.isEmpty())
                                              .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                                                  word -> word,
                                                  word -> 1,
                                                  Integer::sum,
                                                  HashMap::new
                                              ));
        
        // 按頻率排序並取前 N 個
        return wordCount.entrySet()
                       .stream()
                       .sorted(Map.Entry.<String, Integer>comparingByValue().reversed())
                       .limit(topN)
                       .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                           Map.Entry::getKey,
                           Map.Entry::getValue,
                           (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue,
                           LinkedHashMap::new
                       ));
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String sampleText = "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. " +
                           "The dog was really lazy and the fox was very quick.";
        
        Map<String, Integer> topWords = analyzeWordFrequency(sampleText, 5);
        
        System.out.println("Top 5 most frequent words:");
        topWords.forEach((word, count) -> 
            System.out.printf("  %s: %d times\n", word, count));
    }
}

/**
 * 使用者評分排序系統
 */
public class UserRatingSystem {
    
    public static class UserRating {
        private final String userId;
        private final double averageRating;
        private final int totalReviews;
        
        public UserRating(String userId, double averageRating, int totalReviews) {
            this.userId = userId;
            this.averageRating = averageRating;
            this.totalReviews = totalReviews;
        }
        
        public double getWeightedScore() {
            // 加權評分：考慮評論數量
            return averageRating * Math.log(totalReviews + 1);
        }
        
        // getter 方法
        public String getUserId() { return userId; }
        public double getAverageRating() { return averageRating; }
        public int getTotalReviews() { return totalReviews; }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.format("UserRating{userId='%s', avgRating=%.2f, reviews=%d, weighted=%.2f}",
                               userId, averageRating, totalReviews, getWeightedScore());
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 根據加權評分排序用戶
     */
    public static Map<String, UserRating> sortUsersByRating(Map<String, UserRating> users) {
        return users.entrySet()
                   .stream()
                   .sorted(Map.Entry.<String, UserRating>comparingByValue(
                       (r1, r2) -> Double.compare(r2.getWeightedScore(), r1.getWeightedScore())))
                   .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                       Map.Entry::getKey,
                       Map.Entry::getValue,
                       (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue,
                       LinkedHashMap::new
                   ));
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Map<String, UserRating> users = new HashMap<>();
        users.put("user1", new UserRating("user1", 4.5, 100));
        users.put("user2", new UserRating("user2", 4.8, 50));
        users.put("user3", new UserRating("user3", 4.2, 200));
        users.put("user4", new UserRating("user4", 4.9, 25));
        
        Map<String, UserRating> sortedUsers = sortUsersByRating(users);
        
        System.out.println("Users sorted by weighted rating:");
        sortedUsers.values().forEach(System.out::println);
    }
}

/**
 * 排序方法選擇指南
 */
public class SortingMethodSelector {
    
    /**
     * 根據資料特徵選擇最佳排序方法
     */
    public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> smartSort(
            Map<K, V> map, SortingContext context) {
        
        int size = map.size();
        
        // 小資料集：使用 Collections.sort
        if (size < 1000) {
            return sortByValueUsingCollections(map);
        }
        
        // 大資料集且有多核心：使用並行 Stream
        if (size > 100000 && context.isParallelProcessingAvailable()) {
            return sortByValueParallel(map, context.isAscending());
        }
        
        // 中等資料集：使用 Stream API
        return sortByValueUsingStream(map, context.isAscending());
    }
    
    public static class SortingContext {
        private final boolean ascending;
        private final boolean parallelProcessingAvailable;
        
        public SortingContext(boolean ascending, boolean parallelProcessingAvailable) {
            this.ascending = ascending;
            this.parallelProcessingAvailable = parallelProcessingAvailable;
        }
        
        public boolean isAscending() { return ascending; }
        public boolean isParallelProcessingAvailable() { return parallelProcessingAvailable; }
    }
}

/**
 * 常見錯誤和解決方案
 */
public class CommonPitfalls {
    
    /**
     * 錯誤：使用 HashMap 儲存排序結果（會丟失順序）
     */
    public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> wrongApproach(Map<K, V> map) {
        // ❌ 錯誤：HashMap 不保證順序
        return map.entrySet()
                  .stream()
                  .sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                  .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                      Map.Entry::getKey,
                      Map.Entry::getValue,
                      (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue,
                      HashMap::new  // ❌ 這裡應該使用 LinkedHashMap
                  ));
    }
    
    /**
     * 正確：使用 LinkedHashMap 保持順序
     */
    public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> correctApproach(Map<K, V> map) {
        // ✅ 正確：LinkedHashMap 保持插入順序
        return map.entrySet()
                  .stream()
                  .sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                  .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                      Map.Entry::getKey,
                      Map.Entry::getValue,
                      (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue,
                      LinkedHashMap::new  // ✅ 正確
                  ));
    }
    
    /**
     * 處理 null 值的排序
     */
    public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortWithNulls(Map<K, V> map) {
        return map.entrySet()
                  .stream()
                  .sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByValue(
                      Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder())))
                  .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                      Map.Entry::getKey,
                      Map.Entry::getValue,
                      (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue,
                      LinkedHashMap::new
                  ));
    }
}

/**
 * 執行緒安全的 Map 排序
 */
public class ThreadSafeSorting {
    
    /**
     * 對 ConcurrentHashMap 進行安全排序
     */
    public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortConcurrentMap(
            ConcurrentHashMap<K, V> concurrentMap) {
        
        // 創建快照避免併發修改
        Map<K, V> snapshot = new HashMap<>(concurrentMap);
        
        return snapshot.entrySet()
                      .stream()
                      .sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByValue())
                      .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                          Map.Entry::getKey,
                          Map.Entry::getValue,
                          (oldValue, newValue) -> oldValue,
                          LinkedHashMap::new
                      ));
    }
    
    /**
     * 返回執行緒安全的排序結果
     */
    public static <K, V extends Comparable<V>> Map<K, V> sortAndMakeThreadSafe(Map<K, V> map) {
        Map<K, V> sortedMap = sortByValueUsingStream(map, false);
        return Collections.synchronizedMap(sortedMap);
    }
}

import com.jcraft.jsch.*;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.apache.commons.pool2.BasePooledObjectFactory;
import org.apache.commons.pool2.PooledObject;
import org.apache.commons.pool2.impl.DefaultPooledObject;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.Properties;

@Slf4j
@Component
public class SftpConnectionFactory extends BasePooledObjectFactory<ChannelSftp> {

    private final SftpProperties sftpProperties;
    private final JSch jsch;

    public SftpConnectionFactory(SftpProperties sftpProperties) {
        this.sftpProperties = sftpProperties;
        this.jsch = new JSch();
        initializeJSch();
    }

    private void initializeJSch() {
        try {
            // 設定私鑰
            if (sftpProperties.getPrivateKeyPath() != null) {
                if (sftpProperties.getPassphrase() != null) {
                    jsch.addIdentity(sftpProperties.getPrivateKeyPath(), sftpProperties.getPassphrase());
                } else {
                    jsch.addIdentity(sftpProperties.getPrivateKeyPath());
                }
            }
            
            // 設定 known_hosts
            if (sftpProperties.getKnownHostsFile() != null) {
                jsch.setKnownHosts(sftpProperties.getKnownHostsFile());
            }
            
            log.info("SFTP JSch 初始化完成");
        } catch (JSchException e) {
            log.error("SFTP JSch 初始化失敗", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("SFTP JSch 初始化失敗", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public ChannelSftp create() throws Exception {
        log.debug("創建新的 SFTP 連線到 {}:{}", sftpProperties.getHost(), sftpProperties.getPort());
        
        Session session = jsch.getSession(
            sftpProperties.getUsername(),
            sftpProperties.getHost(),
            sftpProperties.getPort()
        );
        
        // 設定密碼（如果有）
        if (sftpProperties.getPassword() != null) {
            session.setPassword(sftpProperties.getPassword());
        }
        
        // 設定連線屬性
        Properties config = new Properties();
        config.put("StrictHostKeyChecking", sftpProperties.isStrictHostKeyChecking() ? "yes" : "no");
        
        if (sftpProperties.getHostKeyAlgorithms() != null) {
            config.put("server_host_key", sftpProperties.getHostKeyAlgorithms());
        }
        
        session.setConfig(config);
        session.setTimeout(sftpProperties.getSessionTimeout());
        
        // 建立連線
        session.connect(sftpProperties.getConnectTimeout());
        
        Channel channel = session.openChannel("sftp");
        channel.connect(sftpProperties.getChannelTimeout());
        
        ChannelSftp channelSftp = (ChannelSftp) channel;
        log.debug("SFTP 連線創建成功");
        
        return channelSftp;
    }

    @Override
    public PooledObject<ChannelSftp> wrap(ChannelSftp channelSftp) {
        return new DefaultPooledObject<>(channelSftp);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean validateObject(PooledObject<ChannelSftp> pooledObject) {
        ChannelSftp channelSftp = pooledObject.getObject();
        return channelSftp != null && channelSftp.isConnected();
    }

    @Override
    public void destroyObject(PooledObject<ChannelSftp> pooledObject) throws Exception {
        ChannelSftp channelSftp = pooledObject.getObject();
        if (channelSftp != null) {
            Session session = channelSftp.getSession();
            if (channelSftp.isConnected()) {
                channelSftp.disconnect();
            }
            if (session != null && session.isConnected()) {
                session.disconnect();
            }
        }
        log.debug("SFTP 連線已銷毀");
    }
}

import org.apache.commons.pool2.ObjectPool;
import org.apache.commons.pool2.impl.GenericObjectPool;
import org.apache.commons.pool2.impl.GenericObjectPoolConfig;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

@Slf4j
@Component
public class SftpConnectionPoolManager {

    private final ObjectPool<ChannelSftp> sftpPool;
    private final SftpProperties sftpProperties;

    public SftpConnectionPoolManager(SftpConnectionFactory factory, SftpProperties sftpProperties) {
        this.sftpProperties = sftpProperties;
        this.sftpPool = createPool(factory);
    }

    private ObjectPool<ChannelSftp> createPool(SftpConnectionFactory factory) {
        GenericObjectPoolConfig<ChannelSftp> config = new GenericObjectPoolConfig<>();
        
        config.setMaxTotal(sftpProperties.getPool().getMaxActive());
        config.setMaxIdle(sftpProperties.getPool().getMaxIdle());
        config.setMinIdle(sftpProperties.getPool().getMinIdle());
        config.setMaxWaitMillis(sftpProperties.getPool().getMaxWait());
        config.setTestOnBorrow(sftpProperties.getPool().isTestOnBorrow());
        config.setTestOnReturn(sftpProperties.getPool().isTestOnReturn());
        config.setTestWhileIdle(sftpProperties.getPool().isTestWhileIdle());
        config.setTimeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis(sftpProperties.getPool().getTimeBetweenEvictionRuns());
        config.setMinEvictableIdleTimeMillis(sftpProperties.getPool().getMinEvictableIdleTime());
        
        return new GenericObjectPool<>(factory, config);
    }

    public ChannelSftp borrowConnection() throws Exception {
        return sftpPool.borrowObject();
    }

    public void returnConnection(ChannelSftp channelSftp) {
        if (channelSftp != null) {
            try {
                sftpPool.returnObject(channelSftp);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("歸還 SFTP 連線失敗", e);
            }
        }
    }

    public void invalidateConnection(ChannelSftp channelSftp) {
        if (channelSftp != null) {
            try {
                sftpPool.invalidateObject(channelSftp);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("無效化 SFTP 連線失敗", e);
            }
        }
    }

    public int getActiveConnections() {
        return sftpPool.getNumActive();
    }

    public int getIdleConnections() {
        return sftpPool.getNumIdle();
    }
}

import com.jcraft.jsch.ChannelSftp;
import com.jcraft.jsch.SftpException;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Counter;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Vector;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.function.Function;

@Slf4j
@Component
public class SftpUtil {

    private final SftpConnectionPoolManager connectionPoolManager;
    private final SftpProperties sftpProperties;
    private final ExecutorService executorService;
    
    // 監控指標
    private final Counter uploadCounter;
    private final Counter downloadCounter;
    private final Counter deleteCounter;
    private final Counter errorCounter;
    private final Timer uploadTimer;
    private final Timer downloadTimer;

    public SftpUtil(SftpConnectionPoolManager connectionPoolManager, 
                    SftpProperties sftpProperties,
                    MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.connectionPoolManager = connectionPoolManager;
        this.sftpProperties = sftpProperties;
        this.executorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(10);
        
        // 初始化監控指標
        this.uploadCounter = Counter.builder("sftp.upload.total")
                .description("Total number of file uploads")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        this.downloadCounter = Counter.builder("sftp.download.total")
                .description("Total number of file downloads")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        this.deleteCounter = Counter.builder("sftp.delete.total")
                .description("Total number of file deletions")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        this.errorCounter = Counter.builder("sftp.error.total")
                .description("Total number of errors")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        this.uploadTimer = Timer.builder("sftp.upload.duration")
                .description("File upload duration")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        this.downloadTimer = Timer.builder("sftp.download.duration")
                .description("File download duration")
                .register(meterRegistry);
    }

    /**
     * 上傳文件
     */
    public boolean uploadFile(String localFilePath, String remoteFilePath) {
        return uploadTimer.recordCallable(() -> {
            boolean success = executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
                try {
                    createRemoteDirectoryIfNotExists(channelSftp, getParentPath(remoteFilePath));
                    
                    try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(localFilePath)) {
                        channelSftp.put(fis, remoteFilePath);
                        log.info("文件上傳成功: {} -> {}", localFilePath, remoteFilePath);
                        uploadCounter.increment();
                        return true;
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("文件上傳失敗: {} -> {}", localFilePath, remoteFilePath, e);
                    errorCounter.increment();
                    throw new RuntimeException("文件上傳失敗", e);
                }
            });
            return success;
        });
    }

    /**
     * 批量上傳文件
     */
    public List<CompletableFuture<Boolean>> uploadFilesAsync(List<FileTransferRequest> requests) {
        List<CompletableFuture<Boolean>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (FileTransferRequest request : requests) {
            CompletableFuture<Boolean> future = CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> 
                uploadFile(request.getLocalPath(), request.getRemotePath()), executorService);
            futures.add(future);
        }
        
        return futures;
    }

    /**
     * 下載文件
     */
    public boolean downloadFile(String remoteFilePath, String localFilePath) {
        return downloadTimer.recordCallable(() -> {
            boolean success = executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
                try {
                    createLocalDirectoryIfNotExists(getParentPath(localFilePath));
                    
                    try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(localFilePath)) {
                        channelSftp.get(remoteFilePath, fos);
                        log.info("文件下載成功: {} -> {}", remoteFilePath, localFilePath);
                        downloadCounter.increment();
                        return true;
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.error("文件下載失敗: {} -> {}", remoteFilePath, localFilePath, e);
                    errorCounter.increment();
                    throw new RuntimeException("文件下載失敗", e);
                }
            });
            return success;
        });
    }

    /**
     * 下載文件到輸出流
     */
    public void downloadFileToStream(String remoteFilePath, OutputStream outputStream) {
        executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
            try {
                channelSftp.get(remoteFilePath, outputStream);
                log.info("文件下載到流成功: {}", remoteFilePath);
                downloadCounter.increment();
                return true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("文件下載到流失敗: {}", remoteFilePath, e);
                errorCounter.increment();
                throw new RuntimeException("文件下載到流失敗", e);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 獲取文件內容為字符串
     */
    public String getFileContent(String remoteFilePath) {
        return executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
            try (InputStream inputStream = channelSftp.get(remoteFilePath);
                 BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream))) {
                
                StringBuilder content = new StringBuilder();
                String line;
                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                    content.append(line).append("\n");
                }
                
                log.info("獲取文件內容成功: {}", remoteFilePath);
                return content.toString();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("獲取文件內容失敗: {}", remoteFilePath, e);
                errorCounter.increment();
                throw new RuntimeException("獲取文件內容失敗", e);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 刪除文件
     */
    public boolean deleteFile(String remoteFilePath) {
        return executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
            try {
                channelSftp.rm(remoteFilePath);
                log.info("文件刪除成功: {}", remoteFilePath);
                deleteCounter.increment();
                return true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("文件刪除失敗: {}", remoteFilePath, e);
                errorCounter.increment();
                throw new RuntimeException("文件刪除失敗", e);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 列出目錄文件
     */
    public List<SftpFileInfo> listFiles(String remotePath) {
        return executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
            try {
                Vector<ChannelSftp.LsEntry> entries = channelSftp.ls(remotePath);
                List<SftpFileInfo> fileInfos = new ArrayList<>();
                
                for (ChannelSftp.LsEntry entry : entries) {
                    if (!entry.getFilename().equals(".") && !entry.getFilename().equals("..")) {
                        SftpFileInfo fileInfo = new SftpFileInfo();
                        fileInfo.setFilename(entry.getFilename());
                        fileInfo.setSize(entry.getAttrs().getSize());
                        fileInfo.setModifiedTime(entry.getAttrs().getMTime());
                        fileInfo.setDirectory(entry.getAttrs().isDir());
                        fileInfos.add(fileInfo);
                    }
                }
                
                log.info("列出目錄文件成功: {}, 共 {} 個文件", remotePath, fileInfos.size());
                return fileInfos;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("列出目錄文件失敗: {}", remotePath, e);
                errorCounter.increment();
                throw new RuntimeException("列出目錄文件失敗", e);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 檢查文件是否存在
     */
    public boolean fileExists(String remoteFilePath) {
        return executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
            try {
                channelSftp.stat(remoteFilePath);
                return true;
            } catch (SftpException e) {
                if (e.id == ChannelSftp.SSH_FX_NO_SUCH_FILE) {
                    return false;
                }
                throw new RuntimeException("檢查文件存在性失敗", e);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 創建遠端目錄
     */
    public void createRemoteDirectory(String remotePath) {
        executeWithRetry(channelSftp -> {
            try {
                createRemoteDirectoryIfNotExists(channelSftp, remotePath);
                log.info("創建遠端目錄成功: {}", remotePath);
                return true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.error("創建遠端目錄失敗: {}", remotePath, e);
                errorCounter.increment();
                throw new RuntimeException("創建遠端目錄失敗", e);
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * 帶重試機制的執行器
     */
    private <T> T executeWithRetry(Function<ChannelSftp, T> operation) {
        int attempts = 0;
        Exception lastException = null;
        
        while (attempts < sftpProperties.getMaxRetries()) {
            ChannelSftp channelSftp = null;
            try {
                channelSftp = connectionPoolManager.borrowConnection();
                return operation.apply(channelSftp);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                lastException = e;
                attempts++;
                
                if (channelSftp != null) {
                    connectionPoolManager.invalidateConnection(channelSftp);
                    channelSftp = null;
                }
                
                if (attempts < sftpProperties.getMaxRetries()) {
                    log.warn("SFTP 操作失敗，第 {} 次重試", attempts, e);
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(sftpProperties.getRetryDelay());
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        throw new RuntimeException("操作被中斷", ie);
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                if (channelSftp != null) {
                    connectionPoolManager.returnConnection(channelSftp);
                }
            }
        }
        
        throw new RuntimeException("SFTP 操作失敗，已重試 " + sftpProperties.getMaxRetries() + " 次", lastException);
    }

    /**
     * 創建遠端目錄（如果不存在）
     */
    private void createRemoteDirectoryIfNotExists(ChannelSftp channelSftp, String remotePath) throws SftpException {
        if (remotePath == null || remotePath.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        
        String[] dirs = remotePath.split("/");
        String currentPath = "";
        
        for (String dir : dirs) {
            if (dir.isEmpty()) continue;
            
            currentPath += "/" + dir;
            try {
                channelSftp.stat(currentPath);
            } catch (SftpException e) {
                if (e.id == ChannelSftp.SSH_FX_NO_SUCH_FILE) {
                    channelSftp.mkdir(currentPath);
                } else {
                    throw e;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * 創建本地目錄（如果不存在）
     */
    private void createLocalDirectoryIfNotExists(String localPath) throws IOException {
        if (localPath != null && !localPath.trim().isEmpty()) {
            Path path = Paths.get(localPath);
            if (!Files.exists(path)) {
                Files.createDirectories(path);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * 獲取父路徑
     */
    private String getParentPath(String filePath) {
        if (filePath == null) return null;
        
        int lastSlashIndex = filePath.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (lastSlashIndex > 0) {
            return filePath.substring(0, lastSlashIndex);
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * 獲取連線池狀態
     */
    public SftpConnectionPoolStatus getConnectionPoolStatus() {
        SftpConnectionPoolStatus status = new SftpConnectionPoolStatus();
        status.setActiveConnections(connectionPoolManager.getActiveConnections());
        status.setIdleConnections(connectionPoolManager.getIdleConnections());
        return status;
    }
}

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@Slf4j
@Service
public class SftpService {

    private final SftpUtil sftpUtil;
    private static final String TEMP_DIR = System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir");

    public SftpService(SftpUtil sftpUtil) {
        this.sftpUtil = sftpUtil;
    }

    /**
     * 上傳 MultipartFile 到 SFTP
     */
    public boolean uploadMultipartFile(MultipartFile file, String remoteDirectory) {
        String tempFilePath = null;
        try {
            // 創建臨時文件
            tempFilePath = createTempFile(file);
            
            // 構建遠端路徑
            String remoteFilePath = remoteDirectory + "/" + file.getOriginalFilename();
            
            // 上傳文件
            boolean success = sftpUtil.uploadFile(tempFilePath, remoteFilePath);
            
            if (success) {
                log.info("MultipartFile 上傳成功: {}", file.getOriginalFilename());
            }
            
            return success;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("MultipartFile 上傳失敗: {}", file.getOriginalFilename(), e);
            return false;
        } finally {
            // 清理臨時文件
            if (tempFilePath != null) {
                cleanupTempFile(tempFilePath);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * 批量上傳文件
     */
    public void uploadFiles(List<MultipartFile> files, String remoteDirectory) {
        for (MultipartFile file : files) {
            uploadMultipartFile(file, remoteDirectory);
        }
    }

    /**
     * 下載文件並返回字節數組
     */
    public byte[] downloadFileAsBytes(String remoteFilePath) {
        String tempFilePath = null;
        try {
            // 創建臨時文件路徑
            tempFilePath = TEMP_DIR + "/" + UUID.randomUUID() + "_download";
            
            // 下載文件
            boolean success = sftpUtil.downloadFile(remoteFilePath, tempFilePath);
            
            if (success) {
                Path path = Paths.get(tempFilePath);
                return Files.readAllBytes(path);
            }
            
            return null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("下載文件失敗: {}", remoteFilePath, e);
            return null;
        } finally {
            // 清理臨時文件
            if (tempFilePath != null) {
                cleanupTempFile(tempFilePath);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * 獲取目錄文件列表
     */
    public List<SftpFileInfo> listDirectoryFiles(String remotePath) {
        return sftpUtil.listFiles(remotePath);
    }

    /**
     * 刪除文件
     */
    public boolean deleteFile(String remoteFilePath) {
        return sftpUtil.deleteFile(remoteFilePath);
    }

    /**
     * 檢查文件是否存在
     */
    public boolean checkFileExists(String remoteFilePath) {
        return sftpUtil.fileExists(remoteFilePath);
    }

    /**
     * 創建臨時文件
     */
    private String createTempFile(MultipartFile file) throws IOException {
        String tempFileName = UUID.randomUUID() + "_" + file.getOriginalFilename();
        Path tempPath = Paths.get(TEMP_DIR, tempFileName);
        Files.write(tempPath, file.getBytes());
        return tempPath.toString();
    }

    /**
     * 清理臨時文件
     */

            Files.deleteIfExists(Paths.get(tempFilePath));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            log.warn("清理臨時文件失敗: {}", tempFilePath, e);
        }
    }

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

import java.util.List;

@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/sftp")
public class SftpController {

    private final SftpService sftpService;

    public SftpController(SftpService sftpService) {
        this.sftpService = sftpService;
    }

    /**
     * 上傳文件
     */
    @PostMapping("/upload")
    public ResponseEntity<String> uploadFile(@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file,
                                           @RequestParam("directory") String directory) {
        try {
            boolean success = sftpService.uploadMultipartFile(file, directory);
            if (success) {
                return ResponseEntity.ok("文件上傳成功");
            } else {
                return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                        .body("文件上傳失敗");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("上傳文件異常", e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                    .body("上傳文件異常: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * 批量上傳文件
     */
    @PostMapping("/upload/batch")
    public ResponseEntity<String> uploadFiles(@RequestParam("files") List<MultipartFile> files,
                                            @RequestParam("directory") String directory) {
        try {
            sftpService.uploadFiles(files, directory);
            return ResponseEntity.ok("批量上傳成功");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("批量上傳文件異常", e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                    .body("批量上傳異常: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * 下載文件
     */
    @GetMapping("/download")
    public ResponseEntity<byte[]> downloadFile(@RequestParam("filePath") String filePath) {
        try {
            byte[] fileBytes = sftpService.downloadFileAsBytes(filePath);
            if (fileBytes != null) {
                return ResponseEntity.ok()
                        .header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=\"" + 
                                filePath.substring(filePath.lastIndexOf("/") + 1) + "\"")
                        .body(fileBytes);
            } else {
                return ResponseEntity.notFound().build();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("下載文件異常", e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build();
        }
    }

    /**
     * 列出目錄文件
     */
    @GetMapping("/list")
    public ResponseEntity<List<SftpFileInfo>> listFiles(@RequestParam("directory") String directory) {
        try {
            List<SftpFileInfo> files = sftpService.listDirectoryFiles(directory);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(files);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("列出目錄文件異常", e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build();
        }
    }

    /**
     * 刪除文件
     */
    @DeleteMapping("/delete")
    public ResponseEntity<String> deleteFile(@RequestParam("filePath") String filePath) {
        try {
            boolean success = sftpService.deleteFile(filePath);
            if (success) {
                return ResponseEntity.ok("文件刪除成功");
            } else {
                return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                        .body("文件刪除失敗");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("刪除文件異常", e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)
                    .body("刪除文件異常: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * 檢查文件是否存在
     */
    @GetMapping("/exists")
    public ResponseEntity<Boolean> checkFileExists(@RequestParam("filePath") String filePath) {
        try {
            boolean exists = sftpService.checkFileExists(filePath);
            return ResponseEntity.ok(exists);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("檢查文件存在性異常", e);
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build();
        }
    }
}

import org.springframework.boot.actuator.health.Health;
import org.springframework.boot.actuator.health.HealthIndicator;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

@Slf4j
@Component
public class SftpHealthIndicator implements HealthIndicator {

    private final SftpUtil sftpUtil;

    public SftpHealthIndicator(SftpUtil sftpUtil) {
        this.sftpUtil = sftpUtil;
    }

    @Override
    public Health health() {
        try {
            // 檢查連線池狀態
            SftpConnectionPoolStatus poolStatus = sftpUtil.getConnectionPoolStatus();
            
            Health.Builder builder = Health.up()
                    .withDetail("activeConnections", poolStatus.getActiveConnections())
                    .withDetail("idleConnections", poolStatus.getIdleConnections())
                    .withDetail("status", "SFTP 服務正常運行");
            
            return builder.build();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("SFTP 健康檢查失敗", e);
            return Health.down()
                    .withDetail("error", e.getMessage())
                    .withDetail("status", "SFTP 服務異常")
                    .build();
        }
    }
}

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith;
import org.mockito.Mock;
import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension;
import org.springframework.test.context.junit.jupiter.SpringJUnitConfig;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class)
@SpringJUnitConfig
class SftpUtilTest {

    @Mock
    private SftpConnectionPoolManager mockConnectionPoolManager;

    @Mock
    private ChannelSftp mockChannelSftp;

    @Mock
    private SftpProperties mockSftpProperties;

    private SftpUtil sftpUtil;

    @BeforeEach
    void setUp() {
        when(mockSftpProperties.getMaxRetries()).thenReturn(3);
        when(mockSftpProperties.getRetryDelay()).thenReturn(1000);
        
        sftpUtil = new SftpUtil(mockConnectionPoolManager, mockSftpProperties, null);
    }

    @Test
    void testUploadFile_Success() throws Exception {
        // Given
        String localPath = "test.txt";
        String remotePath = "/remote/test.txt";
        
        when(mockConnectionPoolManager.borrowConnection()).thenReturn(mockChannelSftp);
        
        // When
        boolean result = sftpUtil.uploadFile(localPath, remotePath);
        
        // Then
        assertTrue(result);
        verify(mockChannelSftp, times(1)).put(any(InputStream.class), eq(remotePath));
        verify(mockConnectionPoolManager, times(1)).returnConnection(mockChannelSftp);
    }

    @Test
    void testDownloadFile_Success() throws Exception {
        // Given
        String remotePath = "/remote/test.txt";
        String localPath = "test.txt";
        InputStream mockInputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream("test content".getBytes());
        
        when(mockConnectionPoolManager.borrowConnection()).thenReturn(mockChannelSftp);
        when(mockChannelSftp.get(remotePath)).thenReturn(mockInputStream);
        
        // When
        boolean result = sftpUtil.downloadFile(remotePath, localPath);
        
        // Then
        assertTrue(result);
        verify(mockChannelSftp, times(1)).get(eq(remotePath), any());
        verify(mockConnectionPoolManager, times(1)).returnConnection(mockChannelSftp);
    }

    @Test
    void testFileExists_FileExists() throws Exception {
        // Given
        String remotePath = "/remote/test.txt";
        
        when(mockConnectionPoolManager.borrowConnection()).thenReturn(mockChannelSftp);
        when(mockChannelSftp.stat(remotePath)).thenReturn(null); // 不拋出異常表示文件存在
        
        // When
        boolean result = sftpUtil.fileExists(remotePath);
        
        // Then
        assertTrue(result);
        verify(mockChannelSftp, times(1)).stat(remotePath);
        verify(mockConnectionPoolManager, times(1)).returnConnection(mockChannelSftp);
    }
}

// 使用批量操作
@Component
public class SftpBatchProcessor {
    
    public void processBatchUpload(List<FileTransferRequest> requests) {
        // 分批處理大量文件
        int batchSize = 10;
        for (int i = 0; i < requests.size(); i += batchSize) {
            List<FileTransferRequest> batch = requests.subList(i, 
                Math.min(i + batchSize, requests.size()));
            processBatch(batch);
        }
    }
    
    private void processBatch(List<FileTransferRequest> batch) {
        // 並行處理批次
        List<CompletableFuture<Boolean>> futures = 
            sftpUtil.uploadFilesAsync(batch);
        
        // 等待所有任務完成
        CompletableFuture.allOf(futures.toArray(new CompletableFuture[0])).join();
    }
}

@Component
public class SftpErrorHandler {
    
    public void handleSftpError(Exception e, String operation, String filePath) {
        if (e instanceof SftpException) {
            SftpException sftpException = (SftpException) e;
            switch (sftpException.id) {
                case ChannelSftp.SSH_FX_NO_SUCH_FILE:
                    log.warn("文件不存在: {}", filePath);
                    break;
                case ChannelSftp.SSH_FX_PERMISSION_DENIED:
                    log.error("權限不足: {}", filePath);
                    break;
                case ChannelSftp.SSH_FX_CONNECTION_LOST:
                    log.error("連線中斷: {}", filePath);
                    // 觸發重連
                    break;
                default:
                    log.error("SFTP 操作失敗: {} - {}", operation, filePath, e);
            }
        } else {
            log.error("一般錯誤: {} - {}", operation, filePath, e);
        }
    }
}

        dataSource.setUsername("user");
        dataSource.setPassword("password");
        return dataSource;

    @Bean

    @Bean

    public OrderProcessor orderProcessor() {

    @Bean
    @Lazy  // 延遲初始化
    public ExpensiveService expensiveService() {
        return new ExpensiveService();
    }
}

@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)

預設 proxyBeanMethods = true：Spring 會用 CGLIB 代理 @Configuration 類別，確保 @Bean 方法之間互相呼叫時回傳的是同一個 singleton。

item.title: Java Map 計算方法完整指南：高效能數據操作與最佳實踐
item.description:
概述

Java 8 引入了多個強大的 Map 計算方法，這些方法提供了原子性的讀取-計算-寫入操作，不僅簡化了程式碼，也提高了執行效率和執行緒安全性。本文將深入探討這些方法的使用場景、效能特性和最佳實踐。

核心計算方法

  • putIfAbsent：條件式插入，僅在 Key 不存在時插入值
  • compute：基於 Key 和現有 Value 計算新值
  • computeIfAbsent：Key 不存在時執行計算並插入
  • computeIfPresent：Key 存在時執行計算並更新
  • merge：合併現有值與新值

優勢與特點

  1. 原子性操作：避免 Check-Then-Act 競態條件
  2. 效能優化：減少重複的查找操作
  3. 簡潔語法：使用 Lambda 表達式簡化程式碼
  4. 執行緒安全：與 ConcurrentHashMap 結合提供執行緒安全

        demonstratePutIfAbsent(new HashMap<>(map));
        demonstrateCompute(new HashMap<>(map));
        demonstrateComputeIfAbsent(new HashMap<>(map));
        demonstrateComputeIfPresent(new HashMap<>(map));

    }
}

/**
 * putIfAbsent: 僅在 Key 不存在時插入值
 * 返回值：Key 存在時返回現有值，不存在時返回 null（插入後）
 */
public static void demonstratePutIfAbsent(Map<String, Integer> map) {
    System.out.println("\n=== putIfAbsent 示範 ===");
    
    // Case 1: Key 已存在 - 不插入，返回現有值
    Integer result1 = map.putIfAbsent("apple", 99);
    System.out.println("putIfAbsent('apple', 99) 返回: " + result1); // 5
    System.out.println("map 內容: " + map); // apple 仍為 5
    
    // Case 2: Key 不存在 - 插入新值，返回 null
    Integer result2 = map.putIfAbsent("orange", 8);
    System.out.println("putIfAbsent('orange', 8) 返回: " + result2); // null
    System.out.println("map 內容: " + map); // 新增了 orange=8
    
    // Case 3: Value 為 null 的情況
    map.put("grape", null);
    Integer result3 = map.putIfAbsent("grape", 15);
    System.out.println("putIfAbsent('grape', 15) 返回: " + result3); // null
    System.out.println("map 內容: " + map); // grape 被設為 15
}

 * 快取初始化模式：確保每個 Key 只初始化一次
 */
public class CacheInitializationExample {
    
    private final Map<String, ExpensiveObject> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    
    /**
     * 使用 putIfAbsent 實現執行緒安全的快取初始化
     */
    public ExpensiveObject getOrCreateObject(String key) {
        ExpensiveObject existing = cache.get(key);
        if (existing != null) {
            return existing;
        }
        
        // 創建昂貴對象
        ExpensiveObject newObject = new ExpensiveObject(key);
        
        // 原子性插入，避免重複創建
        ExpensiveObject result = cache.putIfAbsent(key, newObject);
        return result != null ? result : newObject;
    }
    
    /**
     * 更簡潔的寫法（但可能創建多餘物件）
     */
    public ExpensiveObject getOrCreateObjectSimple(String key) {
        return cache.putIfAbsent(key, new ExpensiveObject(key));
    }
    
    public static class ExpensiveObject {
        private final String id;
        private final long creationTime;
        
        public ExpensiveObject(String id) {
            this.id = id;
            this.creationTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
            // 模擬昂貴的初始化過程
            try {
                Thread.sleep(10);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
        }
        
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.format("ExpensiveObject{id='%s', created=%d}", id, creationTime);
        }
    }
}

    });
    System.out.println("compute('cherry', ...) 返回: " + result3); // null
    System.out.println("map 內容: " + map); // cherry 被移除
}

/**
 * 複雜計算應用：統計和聚合操作
 */
public class ComputeAdvancedExample {
    
    /**
     * 實現計數器功能
     */
    public static Map<String, Integer> updateCounters(Map<String, Integer> counters, 
                                                     List<String> events) {
        for (String event : events) {
            counters.compute(event, (key, count) -> count == null ? 1 : count + 1);
        }
        return counters;
    }
    
    /**
     * 實現累加器功能
     */
    public static Map<String, Double> updateAccumulators(Map<String, Double> accumulators,
                                                        Map<String, Double> newValues) {
        for (Map.Entry<String, Double> entry : newValues.entrySet()) {
            accumulators.compute(entry.getKey(), (key, current) -> {
                double newValue = entry.getValue();
                return current == null ? newValue : current + newValue;
            });
        }
        return accumulators;
    }
    
    /**
     * 條件式更新：基於複雜邏輯的值計算
     */
    public static Map<String, String> updateStatus(Map<String, String> statusMap,
                                                  String key, String newStatus) {
        return Map.of(key, statusMap.compute(key, (k, currentStatus) -> {
            if (currentStatus == null) {
                return newStatus;
            }
            
            // 狀態轉換邏輯
            switch (currentStatus) {
                case "PENDING":
                    return List.of("PROCESSING", "CANCELLED").contains(newStatus) 
                           ? newStatus : currentStatus;
                case "PROCESSING":
                    return List.of("COMPLETED", "FAILED").contains(newStatus) 
                           ? newStatus : currentStatus;
                default:
                    return currentStatus; // 不允許從終態轉換
            }
        }));
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // 測試計數器
        Map<String, Integer> counters = new HashMap<>();
        List<String> events = Arrays.asList("login", "logout", "login", "error", "login");
        updateCounters(counters, events);
        System.out.println("事件計數: " + counters);
        
        // 測試累加器
        Map<String, Double> accumulators = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, Double> newValues = Map.of("sales", 100.5, "costs", 75.2);
        updateAccumulators(accumulators, newValues);
        System.out.println("累加結果: " + accumulators);
    }
}
